note: Gravel in-town park a block off the main street in Custer, on the Mickelson Trail. RV sites are back-ins; separate van spots and creekside tent sites sit along French Creek at the back. Walkable to restaurants and shops. --Claude
summary: Operator pages + parkwith.us engine page + gateways + Google + imagery: 23 full-hookup back-in RV sites (30/50 A, 42 ft) at $70, 7 van spots (24 ft max, $30-50), 5 tent sites; showers; 14-night max; sites 11-18 year-round with power only. Over $50 but passes the gate by gateway (Mount Rushmore 17 km). Google 4.6/18. Not waterfront (French Creek, creek-size, 80-100 m south). Pin fine.
